response: {"turns":[{"id":"M1:T1","text":"Okay, let's get started. Thanks everyone for joining. This is the kickoff, the first of 4 sessions on the CCTNS project, the Crime and Criminal Tracking Network and Systems under the e-governance Mission Mode Project. Could you start by giving us some background?"},{"id":"M1:T2","text":"Sure. So the main idea behind how we designed CCTNS V1.0 is to concentrate on the critical functionality that actually gives value to the police personnel at the cutting edge, because that's what improves outcomes in \"Investigation of Crime\" and \"Detection of Criminals\". The functionality is really aimed at IOs, records room staff and citizens, all within the broad crime investigation area. Working from those principles, we identified nine different function blocks and worked out the detailed functionality for each one."},{"id":"M1:T3","text":"Great, thanks. Let's start with the general needs. What do you expect from the system across the board?"},{"id":"M1:T4","text":"Well, one thing is the solution should send out alerts, for example email"},{"id":"M1:T5","text":"Okay."},{"id":"M1:T6","text":"or SMS, to the user"},{"id":"M1:T7","text":"Right."},{"id":"M1:T8","text":"if the user opts for it, whenever some action's been taken on the alert."},{"id":"M1:T9","text":"Got it."},{"id":"M1:T10","text":"Also, the user should be able to track a defect or enhancement request they've submitted."},{"id":"M1:T11","text":"And the help-desk user should be able to see reports on those submitted defects or enhancement requests, broken down by category, by status and by age."},{"id":"M1:T12","text":"Okay. What about the help module, what do you need there?"},{"id":"M1:T13","text":"For help, the solution should have detailed, context-sensitive help material covering every possible action and scenario on every user interface in the application."},{"id":"M1:T14","text":"Makes sense. And the audit module?"},{"id":"M1:T15","text":"Right, so an audit trail is basically a record of actions taken either by the user or by system triggers. That covers things users or Administrators do, and also things the system kicks off automatically because of system parameters. The System has to keep an unalterable audit trail that automatically captures and stores information about all the actions, create, read, update, delete, taken on the critical entities, so case—"},{"id":"M1:T16","text":"Sorry, just to check, is that list of entities fixed?"},{"id":"M1:T17","text":"Let me finish the list: case, suspect, property and so on in the system. Plus the user who initiates or carries out the action, the date and time of the event, and administrative parameters. And by \"unalterable\" I mean no user can modify the audit trail data in any way or delete it. It can be re-departmented and copied to removable media if needed, as long as the contents stay unchanged."},{"id":"M1:T18","text":"I'd add, and maybe this isn't strictly mandatory, but once the audit trail functionality has been activated"},{"id":"M1:T19","text":"Mm-hm."},{"id":"M1:T20","text":"the System should track events on its own, without any manual intervention."}]}
